decision.scope: Owner-authorized forward-product extension of T11 phases 2 through 8, remediated after independent review

accepted_extension_scope.responsive_composition: Strict Zod contracts, compact/wide profiles, independent input modes, safe areas, regions, transforms, camera helpers, text-fit diagnostics, unsupported-size handling, overlays, hysteresis, and state-preserving transitions
accepted_extension_scope.presentation: Accessible loading, error, instruction, prompt, progress, HUD, feedback, navigation, and result components with semantic DOM equivalents
accepted_extension_scope.semantic_assets: Owner-approved role/state resolver, selected-union materialization, attribution, and image/frame/animation/tileset/nine-slice/audio/font registration descriptors
accepted_extension_scope.gameplay_and_runtime: Deterministic movement, AABB collision, pooling, spawning, projectile systems, gesture cancellation, responsive composition context, Phaser scene recompose hooks, and resize without canvas recreation
accepted_extension_scope.quality_control: Strict authoring controls, six viewport fixtures, worst-case Thai/English fixtures, deterministic budget monitoring, and provider-neutral browser helpers
accepted_extension_scope.authoring_surface: Working Advantage Games /qc field lab with responsive and accessibility controls, diagnostics, result inspection, semantic binding gallery, and attribution
accepted_extension_scope.scaffold_and_exemplar: Ten-file non-copying public-API scaffold and complete public-API exemplar
